description: Pull requests that are green and clean and that nobody has merged: open, not a draft, CI green at the head, no gate failing or running, no standing request for changes, branch protection satisfied, no conflicts (the merge gate's own conflict probe), and auto-merge NOT armed. Each comes with a plain sentence ("Green and clean for 3 days — nobody has merged it"), whether you can merge it (canMerge) or arm it (canArm), and the merge / arm endpoints. Also `waiting_on_you`: open PRs where you are a requested reviewer or code owner and have not reviewed. Scope: owner + repo for one repository; org for an organisation; neither for every repository you can merge in. `not_ready` lists the other open PRs in scope with the first reason. To act: gluecron_set_auto_merge (arm) or gluecron_merge_pr. Read-only.

org.description: Organisation slug: every repository of the org you can read

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug (with repo)

name: gluecron_list_ready_to_merge
